observations.title: Nevados de Chillan volcano (Chile)
observations.description: The Servicio Nacional de Geología y Minería (SERNAGEOMIN) and the Servicio Geológico Minero Argentino (SEGEMAR) reported that at around 1410 on 18 September a dense ash plume rose 380 m above Nevados de Chillán?s summit and drifted SSE. On 22 September SERNAGEOMIN reported that seismicity indicated eruptive activity; weather conditions prevented views of the summit, though tephra deposits on the flanks were visible. A long-period earthquake associated with fluid movement was recorded on 23 September, but weather conditions again prevented visual observations of the summit. The Alert Level remained at Yellow (the second lowest level on a four-color scale) and the public was warned that an eruption may impact areas within 1 km of the active crater. The Sistema y Servicio Nacional de Prevención y Repuesta Ante Desastres (SENAPRED) maintained an ?Early Preventive Alert? for Pinto and Coihueco. Sources: Servicio Geológico Minero Argentino (SEGEMAR),Servicio Nacional de Geología y Minería (SERNAGEOMIN),Sistema y Servicio Nacional de Prevención y Repuesta Ante Desastres (SENAPRED)
